summary: Describes the common ways that Voice over IP providers connect to each other using SIP peering. It sorts them into static and on-demand setups, and further into direct and indirect ones. The examples are not exhaustive, and this document is informational.

eli5.summary: Two phone companies can be connected by a permanent private line or by finding each other only when a call comes. This document draws out the common ways that happens for internet phone calls.
